decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (FESC/01, H494-NLG-Z1-00-GA-M-49061/P2, H494-NLG-Z1-D0-GA-M-49053/P2, H494-PRP-DR-A-2000 REV, Attachment 3, Attachment 4, Attachment 5 & Attachment 6, received on 16/01/2018;
Noise Impact Statement, received on 19/02/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The condenser units hereby approved shall not be installed and maintained other than in accordance with the details hereby approved.
description: Installation of external condensers in connection with application 00094/AO/P1 for demolition of the existing Feltham Ex-Serviceman's club and surrounding structures and the erection of 94 older person's extra care (C2) units with associated communal facilities, landscaping and parking.
